subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore or tolerate a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes public OpenAI-compatible model-selection semantics and may need a consistent parity decision across Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat a generic body `model` as client compatibility metadata whenever a valid agent header selects the agent, and update docs/tests for the chosen endpoint set.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>`, and steer SDK integrations to those values plus optional `x-openclaw-model`.

options.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

recommendation.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract and related Gateway endpoint behavior this decision would change.
